current_date: Came into effect 22 November 2022 (page published 24 November 2022, last updated 08 May 2025)
current_evidence: The page says 'These webpages set out the Local Validation List for Rochford Council which came into effect for all planning applications received from 22 November 2022' and was last updated 8 May 2025. A web search found no newer list.

issues.detail: List date and Date basis are blank and the list is flagged 'Undated'. The page states an effective date of 22 November 2022, with the page last updated 8 May 2025.
issues.evidence: 'Local Validation List for Rochford Council which came into effect for all planning applications received from 22 November 2022'

issues.detail: For about 20 requirements the trigger excerpt is just the column headings 'What must you do? When is it needed? Why is it needed?' and gives no actual trigger. Examples with their real triggers: Air Quality Assessment (major development, sites over 4 ha, 10,000 sq m or more, AQMA triggers); Construction Management Plan (major applications); Crime Impact Statement (major, or non-major with significant crime risk); Economic Statement (non-residential major); Energy/Renewables Statement (5 or more dwellings, or non-residential 1,000 sq m or more); Health Impact Assessment (10 or more dwellings, or non-residential 1,000 sq m or more); Heritage Statement (within or next to a CA or listed building, and LBC applications); LVIA (major applications); Open Space Assessment (major residential); Planning Statement (major, Green Belt, or listed building); Transport Assessment/Travel Plan (major traffic generating, or 50 or more dwellings); Telecoms statement (prior approval and full applications for masts); FRA (1 ha or more in Flood Zone 1, plus flood zone triggers).
issues.evidence: e.g. Grokbot trigger for Air Quality: 'Supporting Documents Air Quality Assessment What must you do? When is it needed? Why is it needed?'

issues.detail: Some triggers come from the neighbouring section. The Waste/Refuse trigger ('...include locations for pubs and clubs On-Site Renewable and Low Carbon Energy Generation Statement...') is Parking/Energy text, and the source has no separate refuse requirement. The Parking provision trigger is Landscaping Details text ('show minor artefacts and structures (e.g. furniture, play equipment...)'). The source trigger for Parking and Access Details is change of use, new buildings or extensions, new dwellings or commercial uses, and outline/RM where layout is determined.
issues.evidence: Source: Parking and Access Details - 'Change of use'; 'New buildings or extensions'

issues.detail: Householder shows '(none)', but the page says the list applies to householder applications, and several requirements cover householder work. Bat Declaration: roof alterations, alterations or extensions above eaves level, changes to external cladding, demolition. Heritage Statement and Heritage Drawings: works in a Conservation Area or to a listed building. Tree Survey/AIA: trees on or next to the site. Parking and Access Details: new buildings or extensions. Landscaping Details: all applications except those with no change to landscaping.
issues.evidence: 'Bat Declaration ... Applications proposing: a roof alteration, alterations / extensions above eaves level ... demolition'

issues.detail: These local requirements were not captured at all. Alternative Site Assessment: residential development on Metropolitan Green Belt land. BREEAM Statement: new non-residential buildings. Education Assessment: major residential. Equality and Diversity Impact Statement: major applications, plus physical changes to employment, community or public buildings. Foul Sewage and Utilities Assessment: major applications. Land Contamination Assessment: contamination known or suspected. Materials Schedule: new or altered shop fronts, CA/listed building, major. Noise and Vibration Impact Assessment: noise-generating uses near homes, or noise-sensitive uses near a noise source. Play Space/Playing Pitch/Sports Justification: major residential, or loss of play space. Statement of Community Involvement: major applications. Demolition Justification and Site Management Plan: demolition with no redevelopment. Town Centre/Retail/Leisure Impact Assessment: commercial proposals outside a town centre boundary. Tree Survey and AIA: trees on or next to the site. Youth and Community Facilities Assessment: major residential. Heritage Drawings: works to a listed building or in a CA.
issues.evidence: Contents of the Supporting Documents section of the Rochford validation page

issues.detail: All about 37 Full planning rows carry the note 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Outline and Reserved matters are marked '(none)', but the source sets outline triggers: Parameters Plans for outline with some or all matters reserved; Landscaping Details for outline where landscaping is not reserved; Heritage Drawings for outline in a CA; Parking for outline/RM where layout is determined. Grokbot's 'Design Code / Masterplan / Parameter plans' row belongs under Outline. Statement of Agricultural Justification also applies to agricultural prior approvals.
issues.evidence: 'Parameters Plans - Outline applications where some or all matters are reserved'

issues.detail: Structural Survey is placed under Lawful development certificate and Change of use prior approval. The local list covers only householder, full, outline, LBC and advertisement consent applications, and the Structural Survey text sits under Demolition guidance (demolition of listed/locally listed buildings, LB conversions, agricultural building conversions, partial demolition of a dwelling for an extension).
issues.evidence: Page: list applies to 'householder, full, outline, listed building consent and advertisement consent' applications

issues.detail: All six tab_items are fragments or process text, not requirements. They include the self-check questions 'Do I know the correct fee to pay? Do my plans all have scale bars...? 14.'; 'Submitting a planning application Biodiversity Net Gain (PDF) Please do:'; Planning Portal submission instructions; and photo/landscaping guidance that runs across section boundaries. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is also not a requirement; it is advice text inside the Heritage guidance ('engage in pre-application advice').
issues.evidence: Tab item: 'Do I know the correct fee to pay?Do my plans all have scale bars and written dimensions?Are there any other documents I need to submit? 14.'

issues.detail: Single source requirements are split into duplicate rows. 'Planning Obligations / S106' and 'Viability Assessment' share the same affordable housing text (Affordable Housing Statement and/or Viability Appraisal: 10 or more dwellings). 'Transport Assessment' and 'Travel Plan' are one requirement. 'Flood Risk Assessment' and 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' are one requirement. 'Highways / access' and 'Parking provision' both come from Parking and Access Details.
issues.evidence: Source heading: 'Affordable Housing Statement and/or Viability Appraisal - Developments of 10 dwellings or more'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Rochford local list (in effect from 22 Nov 2022, page updated 8 May 2025), but the date was not recorded. Most triggers are empty column headings, about 15 local requirements are missing, and Householder/Outline are wrongly shown as having no local requirements.
